summary: Dreamland Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of up to 6M Class A ordinary shares at $0.75/share (post-split) along with 30M common warrants at $0.05/share exercise price. There is no minimum offering amount. The shares trade on Nasdaq under TDIC; the last sale price was $0.6695 on April 20, 2026. Proceeds to the company before expenses are $4.5M. This is a routine equity raise, not a special situation.
